caption:
Finger food for your event in Sicily.

Golden arancini in wooden cones, mini pizzas with tomato, cheese and basil, salmon and tomato bruschetta, croquette bites, sesame buns, mini burger sliders and little cups for the buffet.

Made and served by the RistHome team, from 25 guests, for private and corporate events in Palermo and all over Sicily. 5.0 on Google with 101 reviews.

Ask for an event proposal on risthome.it (link in bio)
